bibliographic.title: Penelope & Her Guest
bibliographic.author: Surprise Iguana Games
bibliographic.description:
A SHORT AND SPICY ODYSSEY FANFIC

Odysseus has returned to Ithaca after decades at sea. Suitors who want him dead have taken over his house, competing for his wife's hand. His survival depends on surprise.

But does Penelope want him to survive? He's been gone for twenty years... plenty of time to grow accustomed to the throne.

Are these lovers allies or enemies? Neither knows for sure. They play a delicate game, each attempting to lift the other's mask without dislodging their own.
